name: Taiki Kudo
main_effect:
[On Play] Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with the [Xros Heart] trait among them to your hand, and place 1 Digimon card with the [Xros Heart] trait under this Tamer. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.
[Your Turn] When you would play 1 Digimon with DigiXros requirements, by suspending this Tamer, you may place cards from under your Tamers as digivolution cards for a DigiXros.
source_effect: Security Effect [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
tcgplayer_name: Taiki Kudo (Digimon Animation Series 25th Anniversary Set)
